summary: Iteration 200: Tested ECG page BLE state management and ECG detail page real data display. All features working correctly. Backend ECG endpoints (start, history, detail) return proper data. Frontend ECG page shows BLE connection status, ECG detail page fetches and displays real V8 data (waveform, FC, HRV, Respiration, Stress, Humeur, Tension, Age vasc.).
critical_code_review_comments: Console warning: 'No route named sleep exists' - minor routing issue, not blocking functionality
seed_data_creation: None - used existing ECG test data (ID: b5896557-c9ff-4409-8c8a-a7644b3cac3f)
context_for_next_testing_agent: ECG features fully functional. BraceletBLEContext provides global BLE state. ECG page checks bleConnected from context. ECG detail page fetches /api/ecg/{id} for full record with waveform data. Backend stores V8 ECG data with all vitals (bpm, hrv, breath_rate, stress, mood, systolic, diastolic, vascular_aging).

ecg_page_ble_status.details: Shows 'Bracelet non connecte' with red indicator when BLE not connected

ecg_page_connect_button.details: 'Connecter le bracelet' button visible and redirects to /bracelet-connect

ecg_detail_real_data.details: Fetches and displays real ECG data from /api/ecg/{id}

ecg_detail_no_records.details: Shows 'Aucun ECG enregistre' message when no records exist

backend_ecg_history.details: GET /api/ecg/history returns ECG records without data array

bracelet_connect_page.details: Loads without errors, shows Demo V8 button
